base.sampling_caveat: Control extras use frames 5,25,...485. Learned-policy extras use 25 unique evenly spaced candidates per episode from positive multiples of 5, including the first and last candidate. Early deaths prevent matching the frame stride. The comparison changes visited states and within-episode sampling density; it does not isolate those effects. Neither arm pads or repeats candidate row indices; exact input overlap with the base is retained and reported.

interpretation: Exploratory single-initialization matched-budget data-collection comparison. Density, episode horizon, label frequencies, and visited-state distribution change together; the result cannot isolate covariate shift from onset rarity or cadence. Duplicate rows are reported and retained. Smoke metrics do not qualify a teacher; no PPO or student collection follows automatically.
